correctness.rationale: The finite algebraic problem is completely specified: all two-dimensional subspaces of H0(P1xP1,O(2,2)) over F2 whose three rational members are geometrically smooth. In characteristic two, first partial derivatives on each of the four affine charts depend on one coordinate each; the finite-extension argument reduces smoothness to tests over F16, including vanishing derivative cases. Independently implemented GF16 projective-grid evaluation found exactly 144 smooth nonzero forms and 804 unordered pencil triples, and reconstructed all 72 rational automorphisms and 13 orbits of sizes 72x10, 36x2, 12x1. For every orbit representative the original package records four-chart lex Gröbner elimination and independent resultant factors: weighted reduced singular-parameter degree spectra are (2,8):72, (3):192, (3,4,5):72, (3,6):108, (4,8):216, (12):144, summing to 804. Independent exact Gröbner recomputation confirmed the degree-3 and mixed (3,4,5) representatives. The invariant counts reduced geometric parameters, not discriminant multiplicity, singular points or Kodaira types; the proof is an exhaustive FINITE classification and does not pretend to hold over arbitrary finite fields.
